args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Clear the previous error problem state when a new file is chosen via onChange, so old upload error messages are not left visible on screen until the user clicks Upload again.

label: bug

When a new file is chosen via onChange, `setProblem(null)` is not called, leaving the previous upload error message visible on screen until the user clicks Upload again.

Update formatExportFilename to use local date components (getFullYear, getMonth, getDate) instead of toISOString(), so export filenames reflect the local date of the user's Date object rather than UTC.
